text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Sync Back to Salesforce

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Line Item Updates Synced

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Create, Update, or Delete Invoice Line Items in
Salesforce. A trigger automatically executes to
synchronize these changes.

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Updates to Invoice Line Items are synchronized
between Xero and Salesforce.

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Sync Invoice to Xero

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Open Invoice Record and View Synced Details

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Navigate to Work Order record in Salesforce and
click Quick Action: "Create Invoice". Enter invoice
information in the modal, select Quote Items, and
click "Submit".

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: User modifies Invoice or Line Items directly within
Xero.

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: View Synced Xero Details

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Click "Go To Invoice" to navigate to the Salesforce
Invoice record. View synced Xero details and click
the Xero Invoice URL to open the invoice in Xero.

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Updated Xero details are visible on the Salesforce
Invoice record after synchronization.

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Invoice Updated Directly in Xero

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Synchronized Invoice Fields

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Start Invoice Creation in Salesforce

text.style: font: bold 22.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Two-Way Xero ↔ Salesforce Invoice Sync

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Synchronized Invoice Line Item Fields

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Includes Xero Line Item ID, Xero Tax Code, and Xero
Account Code.

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Includes Xero Invoice ID, Xero Contact ID, Xero
Invoice URL, Xero Last Sync Date, Xero Sync
Message, Xero Sync Status, Invoice Status,
Subtotal Amount, Tax Amount, and Total Amount.

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Integration sends Invoice & Line Item data to Xero.
Xero creates the corresponding Invoice and
calculates Subtotal Amount, Tax Amount, and Total
Amount.

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Contact Field Used for Sync

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Update Invoice Line Items in Salesforce

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Contact Field Used for Sync

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: The Xero Contact ID is used for synchronizing
contact information.

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: The Xero Contact ID is used for synchronizing
contact information.

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Related Invoice is updated in Xero. Tax, Subtotal,
and Total are recalculated in Xero. Line Item
updates are synchronized.

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Integration Configuration for Sync

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Xero Invoice ID, Xero Contact ID, and Xero Invoice
URL are stored in Salesforce. Sync Status, Last
Sync Date, and Sync Message are updated.

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Sync Updated Data to Xero

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Integration Configuration for Sync

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Utilizes Custom Metadata Types including External
Endpoint Body Field Mapping, External System
Config (Client ID, Client Secret, Organization ID),
and External System Endpoint Detail (API
endpoints).

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Utilizes Custom Metadata Types including External
Endpoint Body Field Mapping, External System
Config (Client ID, Client Secret, Organization ID),
and External System Endpoint Detail (API
endpoints).

text.style: font: bold 15px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Update Salesforce Invoice with Xero Details

text.style: font: 13.5px Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: pre;
text.tspan: Updated Invoice data and Line Item data are
synced back to Salesforce. Sync status and
timestamps are refreshed.
